Behaves the same as neovim
- Operating system/version: Ubuntu 16.10
- Terminal name/version: tmux
- `$TERM`: screen-256color (xterm-256color outside of tmux)

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

Since `termguicolors` must be set at startup, here's a minimal vimrc:

```
set bg=dark
colorscheme desert
set termguicolors
```

### Actual behaviour

Neovim only uses colours from my terminal's colour scheme (black/white/bold)

### Expected behaviour

Colour support (256 if not truecolor)
